site.title: AlternativeTo
site.short_description: Software alternatives directory. Submit a free listing on a review queue, or pay to expedite. OpenQuok fills manage-item; optional Priority or Finish tiers stay manual checkout.
site.long_description: AlternativeTo lists software with tags, platforms, and license type. Add or edit apps at manage-item after you sign in and verify email. Listings are English-only; web apps should use Online or SaaS under Platforms. Approved app pages link to your official website — confirm rel on the live software page after publish. Track submissions on my submissions. After submit, optional paid Priority Review ($15) or We finish it ($29) expedite review — checkout on AlternativeTo.

opportunities.title: Free listing
opportunities.approval_time_hint: Long free-queue backlog; publish timing is not guaranteed
opportunities.cost_note: Free path ($0). Optional post-submit upsells: Priority Review ($15) or We finish it ($29) on AlternativeTo.
opportunities.description: List your app at no cost on AlternativeTo manage-item. OpenQuok fills name, descriptions, website, tags, platforms, author, pricing, icon, and screenshots after you sign in. Submit on AlternativeTo and wait in the free review queue. Approved listings get a permanent app page with a link to your official website — confirm rel after publish.

steps.title: Read listing rules
steps.body: Listings are English-only. Web apps should pick Online or SaaS under Platforms only. Strip promo links from descriptions per AlternativeTo FAQ.

steps.title: Verify email and sign in
steps.body: Create or open your AlternativeTo account. Verify email before your first submission. Sign in with Google, GitHub, Apple, or email.

steps.title: Fill manage-item
steps.body: Open https://alternativeto.net/manage-item/. Use OpenQuok to fill the listing cards. Icon should be at least 280 pixels. Features, supported languages, alternatives, and final Submit stay manual on AlternativeTo.

steps.title: Submit and track
steps.body: Submit the application on AlternativeTo. Skip paid upsells if you want the free queue. Track status on https://alternativeto.net/my-submissions/?src=account_menu.

steps.title: Verify after publish
steps.body: When AlternativeTo publishes your app, open the live /software/ page. Confirm the official website link and rel. Save your live listing URL.

opportunities.title: Priority review
opportunities.approval_time_hint: Usually about 1–2 business days after $15 checkout (not guaranteed approval)
opportunities.cost_note: $15 one-time Priority Review on AlternativeTo after you submit manage-item — expedited queue, not guaranteed approval.
opportunities.description: Same manage-item form as the free listing. OpenQuok fills the application; you submit and pay $15 for Priority Review on AlternativeTo. Expedited review is typically 1–2 business days — approval is not guaranteed.

steps.title: Compare free and paid
steps.body: Priority Review ($15) expedites the queue vs the free backlog. We finish it ($29) is a separate concierge tier on AlternativeTo.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.body: Sign in on AlternativeTo with a verified email account.

steps.title: Fill and submit
steps.body: Open https://alternativeto.net/manage-item/. Use OpenQuok to complete the listing form and submit the application on AlternativeTo.

steps.title: Pay Priority Review
steps.body: On the post-submit upsell, choose Priority Review ($15) and complete checkout on AlternativeTo. OpenQuok does not run payment.

steps.title: Track and verify
steps.body: Watch progress on https://alternativeto.net/my-submissions/?src=account_menu. After publish, confirm the official website link on your live app page.

opportunities.title: We finish it
opportunities.approval_time_hint: Usually about 1–2 business days after $29 checkout (not guaranteed approval)
opportunities.cost_note: $29 one-time We finish it on AlternativeTo — staff completes missing fields; not guaranteed approval.
opportunities.description: OpenQuok prefills manage-item after you sign in. Pay $29 for We finish it on AlternativeTo so their team completes remaining fields and pushes review. Checkout and tier choice stay on AlternativeTo.

steps.title: Compare paid tiers
steps.body: We finish it ($29) includes concierge completion vs Priority Review ($15) which only expedites the queue.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.body: Sign in on AlternativeTo with a verified email account.

steps.title: Fill what you can
steps.body: Open https://alternativeto.net/manage-item/. Use OpenQuok to fill core listing fields. Submit the application when ready.

steps.title: Pay We finish it
steps.body: On the post-submit upsell, choose We finish it ($29) and complete checkout on AlternativeTo.

steps.title: Track and verify
steps.body: Follow status on https://alternativeto.net/my-submissions/?src=account_menu. After publish, open your live app page and confirm the website link.

opportunities.title: User profile
opportunities.description: Update your public AlternativeTo profile with social handles and LinkedIn at no cost. OpenQuok fills user edit after you sign in. Twitter, Reddit, Instagram, YouTube, and GitHub expect handles; LinkedIn expects a full URL. Reddit is not mapped in OpenQuok v1 — add it manually if needed.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.body: Sign in on AlternativeTo with Google, GitHub, Apple, or email.

steps.title: Open user edit
steps.body: Go to https://alternativeto.net/user/edit/. Use OpenQuok to fill social handles (no full URLs where AlternativeTo expects usernames) and your LinkedIn profile URL.

steps.title: Save and verify
steps.body: Save on AlternativeTo. Open your public profile URL and confirm each link works. Add Reddit manually if you use it.
